description: Import a 3D model file (.obj/.fbx/.usd) and render it to a TOP: a File In SOP reading `model_path`, fed into a Geometry COMP, with a Camera, a Light, and a Render TOP output as a Null. Omit `model_path` to fall back to a default primitive so the network still builds with no dependencies. Exposes RotateY (spin), Zoom (camera distance) and Scale knobs — the imported-model sibling of create_3d_scene.

expose_controls.description: Expose live RotateY (spin), Zoom (camera distance) and Scale knobs.

model_path.description: Path to a 3D model file (.obj/.fbx/.usd) read by a File In SOP. Omit to fall back to a default primitive so the network still builds and previews with no file dependency.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'model' container is created inside.

rotate_y.description: Initial rotation of the model around Y in degrees (exposed as the RotateY knob).

scale.description: Uniform scale applied to the model (1 = imported size).

zoom.description: Camera distance from the model along Z (exposed as the Zoom knob).

name: import_model
title: Import 3D model
